remedies.title: Let the server inherit its clients' priority: drop _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY
remedies.rationale: By default a QNX server thread runs at the priority of the client whose message it receives, so a high-priority request is served at high priority. _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY turns that off: the server stays at its own low priority and any medium-priority thread delays the high-priority client's reply.

remedies.title: Deadline misses in 'brake': a symptom
remedies.rationale: deadline miss is the visible effect; the trace also shows its cause (priority_inversion). It is expected to clear with that fix, and the re-trace checks that it does.
